issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Animal.name attribute to be a StringBuilder for efficient string manipulations, but the provided solution's Animal class defines the name attribute as a String. This mismatch contradicts the specification and could confuse students about the required type for the name field and the required getter/setter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution (and any template guidance) with the problem statement by changing the Animal.name attribute to use java.lang.StringBuilder and provide corresponding getter and setter methods that accept/return StringBuilder (or clearly document and test for an accepted alternative). Update solution code and any examples to use StringBuilder for the name to match the specification.
